title: 第7章 夜闯矿栈第8章 裴家暗手
lines: 沈照夜出门前，把照夜留在了床下。
旧布条重新缠好，断剑压在松动地砖下面。
沈霜低头看了一眼床下，没有再问。
她只是把那枚铜钱递给他。
可握进掌心时，他心里反而稳了一点。
沈霜说：“哥，别为了爹的事，把自己也赔进去。”
但她知道，这是沈照夜能给的最大实话。
夜色落下时，沈照夜从西偏院后墙翻了出去。
离了照夜，那些剑怨像没了镇物，沿着骨缝乱撞。
外墙下，有人蹲在树影里。
“再晚半刻，我就以为你被妹妹锁屋里了。”
周野扛着旧铁镐，嘴里叼着草。
周野举手：“她没说别的。只说你今晚多半会去送死，让我如果不想昨夜白忙一场，就在这里等。”
“我也想。”周野吐掉草，“可我这人有个毛病，越说不让我管，我越想看看热闹。”
“行，我说实话。黑石矿栈我熟。你一个外人走进去，还没找到旧水井，先掉进废沟里。”
两人沿后山小路往黑石矿栈走。
远处矿灯亮得很少，只有三盏。按理说，昨夜出了伏击，矿栈今晚应该封洞。
可西塌洞方向，反而有光。
content_en:
Before Shen Zhaoye went out, he left Zhaoye under the bed.
The old cloth strips were wrapped again, and the broken sword was pressed under the loose floor tiles.
Shen Shuang sat on the edge of the bed and looked at him.
"You don't bring a sword?"
"Can't take it tonight."
"Why?"
"Someone was watching it."
Shen Shuang looked down at the bed and didn't ask again.
She just handed him the copper coin.
"Bring this."
Shen Zhaoye took the copper coins.
Copper coins are very light.
Much lighter than the night.
But when he held it in his palm, he felt a little calmer.
Shen Shuang said: "Brother, don't pay for yourself because of dad's affairs."
Shen Zhaoye was silent for a moment.
"I'll bring myself back first."
It wasn't the reassurance she wanted to hear.
But she knew that this was the greatest truth Shen Zhaoye could give.
When night fell, Shen Zhaoye climbed out from the back wall of the west courtyard.
After leaving Zhaoye, those swords seemed to have lost their weight and were bumping along the bones.
Under the outer wall, someone was squatting in the shadow of the tree.
"Had it been a moment later, I would have thought you were locked in the room by your sister."
Zhou Ye was carrying an old iron pickaxe and holding grass in his mouth.
"How did you know I was going?"
"Miss Lin came to see me."
Shen Zhaoye frowned.
Zhou Ye raised his hand: "She didn't say anything else. She just said that you will probably die tonight. If I don't want to work in vain last night, I can just wait here."
"You can wait."
"I want to, too." Zhou Ye spat out the grass, "But there's something wrong with me. The more you say you don't want me to control it, the more I want to see the excitement."
Shen Zhaoye looked at him.
Zhou Ye felt uncomfortable being looked at.
"Okay, I'll tell the truth. I'm familiar with the Blackstone Mine Stack. You walked in as an outsider and fell into the abandoned ditch before you found the old well."
Shen Zhaoye didn't chase him away again.
The two of them walked along the back mountain path towards the black stone mine stack.
There were only three miner's lamps in the distance that were bright. It stands to reason that since there was an ambush last night, the mine stack should be sealed tonight.
But in the direction of the west cave, there is light.
Zhou Ye stopped on the slope.
title_en: Chapter 7 Breaking into the Mine at Night Chapter 8 The Pei Family's Secret Hand
